title: Handling of S-NSSAI based congestion control

entities.name: S-NSSAI based congestion control
entities.description: Network procedure for detecting and controlling congestion based on S-NSSAI criteria as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501. The network starts this control when congestion criteria are met.

entities.name: Timer T3584
entities.description: 5GS session management timer for S-NSSAI based congestion control, started and stopped per S-NSSAI, DNN, and PLMN/SNPN basis. Prevents UE from initiating certain procedures when running.

entities.name: Timer T3585
entities.description: 5GS session management timer for S-NSSAI based congestion control, started and stopped per S-NSSAI and PLMN/SNPN basis. Prevents UE from initiating certain procedures when running.

entities.name: 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE
entities.description: Information element that indicates how back-off timers should be applied, including ABO bit for all PLMNs and CATBO bit for current access type.

entities.name: ABO bit set to 'The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs'
entities.description: Condition where the ABO bit in the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE is set, causing timers T3584/T3585 to apply to all PLMNs.

entities.name: CATBO bit set to 'The back-off timer is applied in the current access type'
entities.description: Condition where the CATBO bit in the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE is set, causing timer T3585 to apply only to the current access type.

entities.name: Blocked procedures during timer running
entities.description: Property describing that UE is not allowed to initiate PDU session establishment, modification, or NAS transport for CIoT user data when T3584/T3585 is running, unless high priority access or PS data off status change.

entities.name: Timer association with S-NSSAI and DNN
entities.description: Property describing how timers T3584 and T3585 are associated with S-NSSAI (including no S-NSSAI) and DNN (including no DNN) combinations based on UE-provided parameters during PDU session procedures.

relations.description: S-NSSAI based congestion control starts timer T3584 when congestion criteria are met.
S-NSSAI based congestion control starts timer T3585 when congestion criteria are met.
The 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE includes the ABO bit condition that determines timer application scope.
The 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE includes the CATBO bit condition that determines access type scope for T3585.
ABO bit set condition establishes that timer T3584 applies to all PLMNs.
ABO bit set condition establishes that timer T3585 applies to all PLMNs.
CATBO bit set condition establishes that timer T3585 applies only to the current access type.
When timer T3584 is running or deactivated, it establishes that UE is blocked from initiating certain procedures.
When timer T3585 is running or deactivated, it establishes that UE is blocked from initiating certain procedures.
Property defines how timer T3584 is associated with S-NSSAI and DNN combinations.
Property defines how timer T3585 is associated with S-NSSAI combinations.
